english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that something happened at an earlier time, including in “I've never done this before.”
Use 以前 as the all-purpose choice for something happening at an earlier time.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for something that was true at some time in the past.
Use this for a former period or an earlier state, especially when contrasting it with the present.
Use 以前 when back refers to an earlier time or a time ago.
